title: Quake II
shortDescription: Space Marine Bitterman assaults the cybernetic alien Strogg homeworld with hardware 3D OpenGL acceleration.
historicalSignificance: A technological triumph establishing colored dynamic lighting and hardware 3D acceleration as mandatory PC gaming standards.

sourceReferences: Video Game History Foundation Preservation Archive
